summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to identify and disseminate best practices for preventing suicide and improving mental health among educators, establish a national awareness initiative to encourage educators to seek mental health support, and award grants to eligible entities to create or enhance programs promoting mental health and resiliency for school staff.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving the mental health and well-being of education professionals and school staff through various programs, grants, and initiatives. This directly relates to the functioning and support of public schools, implying increased spending to support the staff within these institutions.
